items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: And on that show it was Perry Como and Nat Cole, Roy Hamilton, Ralph Marterie band, Peg Leg Bates, Sarah Vaughn, and a cast of thousands, I guess you could say.

ctx.x: Who were the other members that I wouldn't know?

Well, the reason I say that you wouldn't know is because I can't even remember them, but there was a couple, I tell you, I got the -- piano player and the bass player, I got them in San Francisco, and the 3 of us went up -- the trumpet player, Woodman and myself -- and I can see the trumpet player, but I can't remember -- Bates. Oh, I knew it would come up. His name was Bates. The trumpet player was named Bates.

And for a while, there was a girl that played good piano in San Francisco, and we used her for a while. I can't recall her name; she played, as I used to say -- she'd open us and she played good piano for a woman, you know.
